title: Automated Design Optimization via Strategic Search with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.22651v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Optimization methods have long advanced many fields, yet they struggle when faced with design problems where the search space and design parameters are difficult to define. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative by dynamically interpreting design spaces and leveraging encoded domain knowledge. To this end, we present AUTO: an iterative optimization framework that treats design optimization as a strategic search guided by LLM reasoning. The framework separates high-level planning by a Strategist agent from low-level implementation by concurrent Implementor agents, iteratively refining designs through explore-exploit strategies. We demonstrate AUTO on three GPU code optimization problems. For chemical kinetics, AUTO outperforms in-lab-optimized code by up to 1.74$\times$ for problem sizes up to $10^5$ cells. For matrix multiplication, AUTO achieves up to 94\% of cuBLAS double-precision performance. For KernelB

translated_title: 基于大型语言模型策略性搜索的自动化设计优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.22651v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：优化方法长期以来推动了众多领域的发展，但在面对搜索空间和设计参数难以定义的设计问题时，它们往往力不从心。大型语言模型（LLMs）通过动态解释设计空间并利用编码的领域知识，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。为此，我们提出了AUTO：一个迭代优化框架，将设计优化视为由LLM推理引导的策略性搜索。该框架将高级规划（由策略代理负责）与低级实现（由并发实现代理执行）分离，通过探索-利用策略迭代优化设计。我们在三个GPU代码优化问题上展示了AUTO的性能。对于化学动力学问题，在多达10^5个单元的问题规模下，AUTO的性能比实验室优化代码高出最多1.74倍。对于矩阵乘法，AUTO达到了cuBLAS双精度性能的94%。对于KernelB基准测试，AUTO也取得了显著成果。
tldr: AUTO框架利用大型语言模型的策略性搜索，通过策略与实现代理分离及探索-利用策略，在GPU代码优化中实现了显著性能提升，如化学动力学最高1.74倍加速和矩阵乘法达到cuBLAS的94%性能。
en_tdlr: The AUTO framework leverages strategic search with large language models, separating strategy and implementation agents with explore-exploit strategies, achieving significant performance gains in GPU code optimization, such as up to 1.74x speedup in chemical kinetics and 94% of cuBLAS performance in matrix multiplication.
